item.title: [BM] Fahmi Arah 'Penjimatan Lembut' — Kecilkan Acara, Tapi Jangan Harap Bajet Dikaji Semula
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-29

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 29 April, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil — selaku jurucakap kerajaan selepas mesyuarat Majlis Tindakan Ekonomi Negara (MTEN) — umum semua kementerian, agensi, badan berkanun, GLC dan GLIC mesti kecilkan acara rasmi dan kurangkan perbelanjaan operasi. Kementerian Kewangan arah semua kementerian kemukakan cadangan pemotongan bajet sebelum 15 Mei. Namun, Fahmi tegas kata Bajet 2026 tidak akan dibentangkan semula di Parlimen — dakwa pelarasan hanya melibatkan “pengoptimuman perbelanjaan sedia ada” tanpa mengubah rangka kerja keseluruhan.

item.title: Fahmi Orders 'Soft Austerity' — Scale Down Events, But Don't You Dare Retable the Budget
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-29

📌 What Happened

On April 29, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil — speaking as government spokesman after a National Economic Action Council (MTEN) meeting — announced that all ministries, agencies, statutory bodies, GLCs, and GLICs must scale down official events and trim operating expenditure. The Finance Ministry has directed all ministries to propose budget cuts by May 15. However, Fahmi explicitly stated that Budget 2026 will not be retabled in Parliament, insisting the adjustments involve “optimising existing spending” without changing the overall framework.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata 'Tengok Dulu' Soal Potong Gaji Kabinet — PM Yang Tak Ambil Gaji Sendiri Nak Kredit Berkorban Sementara Menteri Simpan Gaji Mereka
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-17

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 17 April, selepas solat Jumaat di Surau Bomba Cyberjaya, Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim ditanya sama ada Malaysia akan ikut jejak Indonesia memotong gaji menteri ketika krisis tenaga global yang semakin teruk. Jawapannya: ‘Tengok dulu.’ Anwar beritahu wartawan bahawa gaji menteri ‘sudah agak rendah’ dan ‘yang penting ialah mereka berkhidmat dengan baik.’ Katanya kerajaan ‘bersedia mempertimbangkan’ pengurangan gaji lagi jika ekonomi merosot, tetapi beralih kepada gestur peribadi beliau yang tidak mengambil gaji sejak 2022. Dua hari kemudian, Fahmi Fadzil sahkan ahli Kabinet ‘bersedia untuk potongan gaji selanjutnya’ — tanpa benar-benar komited.

item.title: Anwar Says 'Let's See' on Cabinet Pay Cuts — The PM Who Hasn't Drawn His Salary Wants Credit for Sacrifice While His Ministers Keep Theirs
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-04-17

📌 What Happened

On April 17, after Friday prayers at Surau Bomba in Cyberjaya, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim was asked whether Malaysia would follow Indonesia in cutting ministerial salaries amid the worsening global energy crisis. His answer: ‘Let’s see.’ Anwar told reporters that ministers’ salaries are ‘already relatively low’ and that ‘what matters is that they serve well.’ He said the government is ‘prepared to consider’ further pay reductions if the economy deteriorates, but pivoted to his own gesture of not drawing a salary since 2022. Two days later, Fahmi Fadzil confirmed Cabinet members are ‘ready for further pay cuts’ — without actually committing to them.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Tangguh Keputusan WFH Penjawat Awam Sampai Lepas Raya — Kerajaan Yang Suruh Rakyat 'Kurangkan Tenaga' Tak Mampu Putuskan Soal Kerja Dari Rumah

item.title: [BM] Johari Kata Perjanjian Dagang 'Batal' — Kemudian Kementeriannya Kata Beliau 'Tersalah Cakap,' Dan Ahli Parlimen PH Sendiri Minta Penjelasan
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada hari Ahad 16 Mac, Menteri Perdagangan Antarabangsa dan Perindustrian Johari Abdul Ghani memberitahu wartawan bahawa Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik Malaysia-AS kini “batal dan tidak sah” susulan keputusan Mahkamah Agung AS yang membatalkan kuasa tarif Trump — “Ia bukan ditangguhkan. Ia sudah tiada, ia batal dan tidak sah,” katanya. Beberapa jam kemudian, kementeriannya sendiri mengeluarkan pembetulan menyatakan menteri telah “tersalah cakap,” tanpa sebarang penjelasan lanjut. Menjelang Isnin, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil memberitahu wartawan selepas mesyuarat Kabinet bahawa MITI akan “terus berunding” dengan Washington, manakala lapan ahli Parlimen PKR mengeluarkan kenyataan bersama menuntut kerajaan jelaskan status perjanjian itu dan memberi amaran ia “berat sebelah.”

item.title: Fahmi Delays WFH Decision for Civil Servants Until After Hari Raya — The Government That Told You to 'Reduce Energy Usage' Can't Even Decide on Working From Home
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced after a post-Cabinet meeting that the government’s decision on implementing work-from-home for civil servants would be delayed until after Hari Raya Aidilfitri. This came just four days after FMT reported on March 13 that the decision was supposed to be made on Tuesday, March 17. Fahmi said “several aspects still need to be refined” and the matter would go to the National Economic Action Council (MTEN) via the Chief Secretary to the Government. He stressed frontline services like healthcare and education would not be affected.

item.title: Johari Says Trade Deal 'Null and Void' — Then His Own Ministry Says He 'Misspoke,' and PH's Own MPs Demand Answers
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On Sunday March 16, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani told reporters the Malaysia-US Agreement on Reciprocal Trade was “null and void” following the US Supreme Court’s decision striking down Trump’s tariff powers — “It is not on hold. It is no longer there, it’s null and void,” he said. Hours later, his own ministry issued a correction stating the minister had “misspoken,” without further explanation. By Monday, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told reporters after Cabinet that MITI would “continue engaging” Washington, while eight PKR backbenchers issued a joint statement demanding the government clarify the deal’s status and warning the agreement was “one-sided.”

item.title: Amir Hamzah Rules Out Stimulus Amid Oil Crisis — Tells Rakyat to 'Reduce Energy Usage' Instead
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

Finance Minister II Amir Hamzah Azizan told reporters on March 16 that no economic stimulus package will be introduced in response to the West Asia conflict. Speaking after the Malaysia Co-Investment Fund (MyCIF) Engagement Day, he said the government’s approach is to “ensure stability over the short term” and urged citizens and companies to “reduce energy usage.” He added that the government bears RM3.2 billion a month in fuel subsidies — up from RM700 million before the crisis.

item.title: Amir Hamzah Rules Out Stimulus Package Amid Oil Crisis — Government's Plan Is to 'Wait and See'
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

On March 16, Finance Minister II Datuk Seri Amir Hamzah Azizan told reporters after launching the Malaysia Co-Investment Fund engagement day in Kuala Lumpur that the government will not introduce an economic stimulus package despite the escalating West Asia conflict. His reasoning: “We do not yet know whether the crisis in West Asia will continue or not. If it does not continue, I think there is no need to implement something like that.” His stated approach: “Look at the short term and ensure the stability that we have.” He confirmed the government is now spending RM3.2 billion a month on fuel subsidies — RM2 billion on petrol and RM1.2 billion on diesel — and encouraged the public and businesses to “reduce energy use.”

item.title: [BM] Akmal Kata Malaysia Mesti 'Percepatkan' Peralihan Tenaga — Tiga Tahun Berkuasa, Dan Perang Terpaksa Beritahu Mereka
item.description:

Category: Economy

Beliau membuat kenyataan ini selepas menghadiri program “Jualan Rahmah Kasih Sayang,” menjawab cadangan akademik bahawa Malaysia perlu mengurangkan kebergantungan bahan api fosil berikutan konflik Asia Barat yang telah menolak minyak melepasi $100 setong dan menutup Selat Hormuz. Akmal menyatakan Malaysia kini mempunyai kira-kira 25% kapasiti terpasang dari sumber boleh diperbaharui dan berkata kerajaan “secara berterusan menilai langkah-langkah” untuk mempercepatkan proses.

item.title: [BM] Anwar Kata '40 Peratus, Tiada Rundingan, Noktah' Kepada Sabah — Sementara Rakyat Lain Disuruh Jimat Cermat Dan Tanam Sayur

item.title: [BM] Guan Eng Dakwa 'Durian Runtuh' RM1.6 Bilion Dari Bon Samurai 2019 — Keuntungan Itu Nasib Forex, Bukan Kepakaran Dasar
item.description:
Said by: Lim Guan Eng, DAP Chairman and MP for Bagan

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-15

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Lim Guan Eng, Pengerusi DAP dan bekas Menteri Kewangan, mengumumkan pada 15 Mac bahawa Malaysia bakal meraih keuntungan RM1.6 bilion daripada bon samurai bernilai 200 bilion yen yang diterbitkannya pada Mac 2019. Merujuk jawapan parlimen daripada Perdana Menteri dan Menteri Kewangan Anwar Ibrahim bertarikh 2 Mac, Guan Eng berkata susut nilai yen sebanyak 27.8% berbanding ringgit — daripada RM3.62 setiap 100 yen semasa terbitan kepada RM2.59 menjelang Disember 2025 — telah mengurangkan nilai pokok bon daripada RM7.2 bilion kepada RM5.2 bilion. Selepas menolak anggaran RM400 juta kos faedah, keuntungan bersih pertukaran asing adalah kira-kira RM1.6 bilion. Bon ini matang pada 2029.

item.title: [BM] Johari Isytihar Perjanjian Dagang AS-Malaysia 'Batal dan Tidak Sah' — Selepas PH Tandatangan Perjanjian Berat Sebelah Dan Diselamatkan Mahkamah
item.description:

item.title: Amir Hamzah Says Economy 'Expected to Remain Strong' in 2026 — While Oil Tops $100, KLCI Crashes, and Cabinet Announces Austerity
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

Finance Minister II Amir Hamzah Azizan told Bernama on March 13, 2026, that Malaysia’s economic performance in 2025 is “expected to continue driving the country’s economic momentum” in 2026. He said this despite acknowledging that the West Asia war had driven oil past US$100 per barrel, and on the same day the Cabinet announced cost-cutting measures including banning Raya open houses and restricting ministerial overseas travel. The KLCI had crashed below 1700 that same day, and the monthly fuel subsidy bill had ballooned to RM3.2 billion.

item.title: Amir Hamzah Tells Malaysians 'Don't Speculate' on Fuel After Special Cabinet — While KLCI Crashes Below 1700 and Subsidy Bill Balloons to RM3.2 Billion
item.description:

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

Finance Minister II Datuk Seri Amir Hamzah Azizan held a press conference after the special Cabinet meeting on March 13 — the meeting that was supposed to deliver the government’s comprehensive crisis response to the West Asia conflict. His headline message: the Malaysian economy “remains resilient,” the government is sourcing additional oil, and Malaysians should stop spreading or acting on speculation about fuel availability because it “could create unnecessary negative consequences.” No new economic relief measures, no targeted aid packages, no toll freezes, no food price interventions — just reassurance.

item.title: Anwar Says RON95 Subsidy Could Hit RM24 Billion — His Solution? 'Pray for Peace'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-13

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim revealed on March 13 that the government’s subsidy bill to maintain RON95 at RM1.99 per litre under the BUDI95 scheme could reach RM24 billion by year-end if the Middle East conflict persists. Speaking after the special Cabinet meeting, Anwar said the calculation was based on a monthly RON95 subsidy cost of RM2 billion. His proposed solution: “We must pray for a swift end to this conflict so that we won’t be burdened any further.” He added that the government would look for “other ways” to fund the subsidy through cost-cutting.

item.title: Government Triples RON95 Subsidy to RM2 Billion — Three Years of 'Reform' Ends With a Bigger Blanket

The announcement came after the Special Cabinet Meeting convened to address the West Asia conflict’s economic impact. The subsidy covers RON95, the most widely used transport fuel in Malaysia, consumed by the vast majority of motorists.

item.title: [BM] Pelan Krisis Minyak Loke: Biar Syarikat Penerbangan Cas Anda Lebih, Amaran Penerbangan Mungkin Dibatal — Selamat Hari Raya

Category: Economy

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 12 Mac 2026, Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke mempengerusikan mesyuarat bersama pengurusan syarikat penerbangan, pengendali lapangan terbang, pembekal bahan api jet dan pihak berkuasa penerbangan untuk membincangkan impak konflik Asia Barat terhadap kos bahan api yang melambung. Loke mengumumkan bahawa Kementerian Pengangkutan telah mencapai “persetujuan prinsip” untuk membenarkan syarikat penerbangan mengenakan bayaran tambahan — surcaj bahan api — kepada pelanggan bagi menampung kos yang meningkat. item.title: [BM] Kabinet Kekal RON95 Pada RM1.99 — Anwar Kata 'Keputusan Sukar' Sambil Mengelak Reformasi Subsidi Tiga Tahun Berturut-turut

item.title: Oil Past $100, Strait of Hormuz Shut, Rakyat Burning Fuel to Commute — Anwar Won't Mandate WFH, Freeze Tolls, Cap Food Prices, or Cut GLC Fat

item.title: Anwar Promised to End Hardcore Poverty by Q1 2026 — It's March 2026 and Nobody's Talking About It
item.description:

Daripada pemansuhan tol, kerajaan membelanjakan RM591 juta pada 2025 semata-mata untuk membekukan kenaikan tol — membayar syarikat konsesi dengan wang awam supaya tidak menaikkan harga yang sepatutnya tidak dikenakan. Tempoh bebas tol perayaan dibatalkan. Struktur asas konsesi lebuhraya — di mana syarikat swasta mengutip hasil terjamin daripada orang awam yang terperangkap sementara kerajaan menjamin keuntungan mereka — kekal sepenuhnya tidak berubah.

item.title: Highway Concessions: Rakyat Pays Tolls to Make Cronies Rich — Toll Abolition Promise Broken AGAIN
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim Administration / Transport Ministry

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: The PH government’s core manifesto promise to abolish or significantly reduce highway tolls has been systematically broken. Instead of toll abolition, the government spent RM591 million in 2025 to merely freeze toll hikes — paying concessionaires with public money to not raise prices they shouldn’t be charging in the first place. Festive toll-free periods were cancelled. The fundamental structure of highway concessions — where private companies collect guaranteed revenue from a captive public while the government underwrites their profits — remains completely unchanged. Abolishing tolls was a core PH campaign promise in both GE14 (2018) and GE15 (2022). Three years into government, the promise has been quietly shelved with no accountability.

item.title: National Debt Servicing Eats 16% of Revenue — Every Sixth Ringgit Goes to Paying Interest
item.description:
Said by: Ministry of Finance / Bloomberg

Category: Economy

Date: 2025-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Malaysia’s debt servicing costs consume approximately 16% of federal government revenue — meaning roughly every sixth ringgit collected in taxes goes straight to paying interest on accumulated debt rather than funding schools, hospitals, or infrastructure. With the debt-to-GDP ratio at 64.6% — above the government’s own 60% target — and 1MDB legacy debt still totalling RM50 billion on the books, fiscal space remains severely constrained. Anwar told Bloomberg that debt pressure would only “ease from end-2028.” The Star reported that 1MDB debt remains “Malaysia’s largest fiscal burden.”

item.title: [BM] Perang Tanah Felda-Terengganu — 15,000 Hektar Dieksploitasi 40 Tahun Tanpa Bayar Negeri Sesen Pun

The PTMP includes the undersea tunnel (now under corruption trial), the Mutiara LRT, and various road projects — all procured without the standard open tender process that PH demands from the federal government.

item.title: [BM] Ledakan Pusat Data Keringkan Air Dan Kuasa — Johor Disuruh Tunggu Hingga 2027 Untuk Bekalan Air

Menjelang Februari 2026, Anwar membekukan semua kelulusan pusat data bukan AI sepenuhnya. Antara 2023 dan 2025, kerajaan telah meluluskan berbilion projek pusat data daripada Microsoft, Google, AWS, Oracle, ByteDance, dan GDS Holdings — tanpa memastikan infrastruktur mampu menyokongnya. item.title: Data Centre Boom Drains Water and Power — Johor Told to Wait Until 2027 for Water Supply
item.description:

By February 2026, Anwar froze all non-AI data centre approvals entirely. Between 2023 and 2025, the government had approved billions in data centre projects from Microsoft, Google, AWS, Oracle, ByteDance, and GDS Holdings — without ensuring the infrastructure could support them. item.title: US Declares 'Victory Against China' After Securing Unlimited Minerals Pledge From Anwar
item.description:

Malaysia also agreed to partner with American firms “to create certainty for businesses to increase production capacity,” essentially guaranteeing US access to Malaysian mineral resources in perpetuity.

item.title: 'Stop Lecturing Us on Sovereign Rights' — US Envoy Told Off Amid Anger Over Trade Deal

item.title: [BM] Kebankrapan Peribadi Naik 5.7% — Trend Kebankrapan Isytihar Sendiri 'Membimbangkan'

item.title: [BM] Pengangguran Belia Terperangkap Pada 12.28% — Satu Daripada Lapan Anak Muda Malaysia Tak Dapat Kerja

item.title: Personal Bankruptcies Rise 5.7% — Self-Declared Bankruptcy Trend 'Growing Concern'

item.title: Rakyat Says 1.3% Inflation is a Lie — 'Don't Know Where Madanon Gets These Numbers'

item.title: Youth Unemployment Stuck at 12.28% — One in Eight Young Malaysians Can't Find Work
item.description:

The “Madani economy” that Anwar celebrates apparently doesn’t include young people.

item.title: [BM] Pengumuman FDI Lawan Pekerjaan Sebenar — Angka RM Nampak Hebat, Tapi Mana Pekerjaan Untuk Rakyat Malaysia?

Category: Economy

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Kerajaan kerap mengumumkan angka Pelaburan Langsung Asing (FDI) yang besar — berbilion ringgit dalam komitmen daripada gergasi teknologi, pengeluar dan pengendali pusat data. Pengumuman ini menjana tajuk berita yang mengagumkan. Walau bagaimanapun, jurang antara FDI yang diumumkan dan pelaburan sebenar yang direalisasikan, dan antara pelaburan dan pekerjaan sebenar rakyat Malaysia, kekal ketara.

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

Pengumuman FDI adalah kemenangan PR yang mudah — anda berdiri di sebelah CEO asing, tandatangan MOU, dan umumkan berbilion. Tetapi FDI diluluskan ≠ FDI direalisasikan (banyak projek ditangguh atau dibatalkan). FDI direalisasikan ≠ pekerjaan rakyat Malaysia (banyak pelaburan berintensif modal dengan pekerjaan minimum, atau menggaji pakar asing). Dan pekerjaan yang diwujudkan sering bukan jawatan berkualiti tinggi, bergaji baik yang menangani cabaran pengangguran dan genangan gaji Malaysia.

item.title: FDI Announcements vs Actual Jobs — RM Numbers Look Great, But Where Are the Jobs for Malaysians?

📌 What Happened

These announcements generate impressive headlines. However, the gap between announced FDI and actual realised investment, and between investment and actual Malaysian employment, remains significant.

🔥 Why It Matters

FDI announcements are easy PR wins — you stand next to a foreign CEO, sign an MOU, and announce billions. But approved FDI ≠ realised FDI (many projects are delayed or cancelled). Realised FDI ≠ Malaysian jobs (many investments are capital-intensive with minimal employment, or employ foreign specialists). And the jobs that are created are often not the high-quality, well-paying positions that address Malaysia’s unemployment and wage stagnation challenges.

Pekerja asing — dianggarkan 2-3 juta berdokumen dan berjuta lagi tanpa dokumen — membayar yuran pengambilan yang melampau, sering menjadi hamba terikat yang terperangkap dalam kitaran ikatan hutang. item.title: Immigration Corruption Syndicates Thrive — Foreign Worker Exploitation a Multi-Billion Ringgit Industry
item.description:

Category: Economy

Malaysia’s immigration system remains plagued by corruption syndicates that exploit millions of foreign workers, extracting billions of ringgit through illegal levies, document fraud, and labour trafficking. Foreign workers — numbering an estimated 2-3 million documented and millions more undocumented — pay exorbitant recruitment fees, often becoming indentured servants trapped in cycles of debt bondage. The multi-tier foreign worker levy system has been delayed repeatedly, creating uncertainty that benefits corrupt intermediaries. US State Department Trafficking in Persons reports have consistently flagged Malaysia’s forced labour issues, particularly in plantation agriculture, construction, and manufacturing.

Said by: Anwar Ibrahim (Finance Minister) and MOF

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Mac 2024, cukai perkhidmatan Malaysia dinaikkan dari 6% ke 8%. Kemudian pada Julai 2025, SST diperluaskan untuk meliputi enam kategori baharu: sewaan dan pajakan, pembinaan, perkhidmatan kewangan, kesihatan swasta, pendidikan, dan perkhidmatan kecantikan. Cukai jualan 5-10% juga dikenakan ke atas buah-buahan import dan “makanan laut premium.” Anwar, yang juga memegang portfolio Menteri Kewangan, menggambarkan pengembangan itu sebagai “perlu” untuk kemampanan fiskal. Straits Times menggambarkannya sebagai sebahagian daripada “periuk panas berita ekonomi buruk” bersama kenaikan tarif elektrik, pemotongan subsidi, dan perubahan gas masak. CNA bertanya: “Perlu, tetapi pada kos apa kepada perniagaan dan pengguna?”

item.title: Electricity Tariff Hike + SST on Electricity — Double Whammy on Rakyat's Monthly Bills
item.description:
Said by: Energy Commission / Consumer Groups

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In March 2024, the government imposed 8% SST on commercial electricity, adding costs that businesses pass directly to consumers through higher prices for goods and services. Combined with the broader SST expansion and diesel subsidy removal, Malaysians faced a triple cost shock: higher fuel, higher electricity costs, and higher prices for everything that uses fuel and electricity — which is everything. Under BN’s GST system, electricity for domestic use was zero-rated, meaning consumers paid no consumption tax on it.

item.title: SST Hiked From 6% to 8%, Then Expanded to Healthcare, Rent, Education — 'Necessary' Tax on the Rakyat
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim (Finance Minister) and MOF

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-03-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In March 2024, Malaysia’s service tax was hiked from 6% to 8%. Then in July 2025, the SST was expanded to cover six new categories: rental and leasing, construction, financial services, private healthcare, education, and beauty services. Sales tax of 5-10% was also imposed on imported fruits and “premium seafood.” Anwar, who also holds the Finance Minister portfolio, described the expansion as “necessary” for fiscal sustainability. The Straits Times described it as part of a “hotpot of bad economic news” alongside electricity tariff hikes, subsidy cuts, and cooking gas changes. CNA asked: “Necessary, but at what cost to businesses and consumers?”

item.title: [BM] Ringgit Jatuh Ke Paras Terendah 26 Tahun — Anwar Kata 'Membimbangkan' Tetapi Ekonomi Sihat
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-02-23

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Februari 2024, ringgit Malaysia jatuh ke 4.7965 berbanding dolar AS — paras terendah sejak Krisis Kewangan Asia 1998. Bloomberg melaporkan ringgit “terdedah kepada kejatuhan ke arah paras rendah tahun lepas” disebabkan kerapuhan politik dan halangan ekonomi. Anwar mengakui kejatuhan itu “membimbangkan” tetapi menegaskan ekonomi kukuh, menunjuk kepada RM329.5 bilion dalam pelaburan yang diluluskan pada 2023 sebagai bukti. Penganalisis menyatakan bahawa walaupun penunjuk makro kelihatan baik, rakyat Malaysia biasa melihat pendapatan boleh guna menyusut apabila kos import meningkat secara menyeluruh.

item.title: Ringgit Crashes to 26-Year Low — Anwar Says 'Concerning' But Economy Is Fine
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2024-02-23

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In February 2024, the Malaysian ringgit crashed to 4.7965 against the US dollar — its lowest since the 1998 Asian Financial Crisis. Bloomberg reported the ringgit was “vulnerable to a drop toward last year’s low” due to political fragility and economic headwinds. Anwar acknowledged the fall was “concerning” but insisted the economy was strong, pointing to RM329.5 billion in approved investments in 2023 as evidence. Analysts noted that while macro indicators looked decent, average Malaysians saw disposable income shrink as import costs rose across the board.

item.title: [BM] Semakan Penyelesaian Goldman Sachs 1MDB — Anwar Ugut Saman, Tiada Apa Berlaku
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2023-08-21

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Pada Ogos 2023, Anwar Ibrahim memanggil penyelesaian Goldman Sachs 1MDB bernilai $3.9 bilion “dilakukan secara tergesa-gesa” di bawah kerajaan terdahulu dan mengugut untuk membawa Goldman ke mahkamah bagi pemulihan yang lebih besar. Beliau berikrar Malaysia akan “memulihkan setiap sen.” Goldman dilaporkan membuat “tawaran baru” sebagai respons. Bertahun kemudian, semakan itu tidak menghasilkan apa-apa yang konkrit — tiada saman, tiada rundingan semula, tiada pemulihan tambahan. CNA mendedahkan butiran yang mencadangkan perjanjian penyelesaian sulit mungkin merugikan Malaysia, dengan Goldman membayar sebahagian kecil daripada kerugian yang difasilitasinya.

item.title: Goldman Sachs 1MDB Settlement Review — Anwar Threatens Lawsuits, Nothing Happens
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2023-08-21

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: In August 2023, Anwar Ibrahim called the $3.9 billion Goldman Sachs 1MDB settlement “done hastily” under the previous government and threatened to take Goldman to court for a larger recovery. He vowed Malaysia would “recover every single sen.” Goldman reportedly made “fresh overtures” in response. Years later, the review has produced nothing concrete — no lawsuit, no renegotiation, no additional recovery. CNA uncovered details suggesting the confidential settlement agreement may have shortchanged Malaysia, with Goldman paying a fraction of the losses it facilitated.

item.title: [BM] Skandal Gerbang Maritim Selangor RM10 Bilion — Laporan SPRM Difailkan Soal Urus Niaga Tanah Dan Saham
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari / Chegubard / MACC

Category: Economy

Date: 2023-08-07

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Aktivis Badrul Hisham Shaharin (Chegubard) memfailkan laporan SPRM pada Ogos 2023 mengenai dakwaan penyelewengan RM10 bilion dalam projek Gerbang Maritim Selangor — pembangunan sepanjang 56km di sepanjang Sungai Selangor. Projek itu dilaporkan melibatkan penjualan saham majoriti dan ratusan ekar tanah milik kerajaan kepada syarikat swasta yang dikaitkan dengan ahli perniagaan Vincent Tan. Amirudin menghantar surat tuntutan kepada MB Kedah Sanusi Md Nor kerana mengulas skandal itu secara terbuka.

item.title: RM10 Billion Selangor Maritime Gateway Scandal — MACC Report Filed Over Land and Shares Deal
item.description:
Said by: Amirudin Shari / Chegubard / MACC

Category: Economy

Date: 2023-08-07

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Activist Badrul Hisham Shaharin (Chegubard) lodged a MACC report in August 2023 over alleged RM10 billion irregularities in the Selangor Maritime Gateway project — a 56km development along the Selangor River. The project reportedly involved the sale of majority shares and hundreds of acres of government-owned land to a private company linked to businessman Vincent Tan. Amirudin sent a letter of demand to Kedah MB Sanusi Md Nor for commenting on the scandal publicly.

item.title: [BM] Kos ECRL Membengkak Kepada RM75 Bilion — Anwar Teruskan Juga, Panggil Ia 'Dikurangkan'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2022-12-01

📌 APA YANG BERLAKU: Anwar Ibrahim mendedahkan bahawa kos asal Laluan Rel Pantai Timur (ECRL) ialah RM86 bilion dan mendakwa kerajaannya “mengurangkan” ia kepada RM75 bilion. Pembinaan sahaja berjumlah RM50.27 bilion, dengan tambahan RM24.69 bilion dalam kos faedah dan pemerolehan tanah. Projek ini — projek mega yang disokong China menghubungkan pantai timur dan barat Semenanjung Malaysia — dirundingkan semula di bawah kerajaan PH 1.0 Mahathir dan diteruskan di bawah Muhyiddin dan Ismail Sabri. Kerajaan Anwar meneruskan pembinaan, membingkaikan “pengurangan” RM11 bilion sebagai pencapaian fiskal.

item.title: ECRL Cost Balloons to RM75 Billion — Anwar Proceeds Anyway, Calls It 'Reduced'
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2022-12-01

📌 WHAT HAPPENED: Anwar Ibrahim revealed that the original East Coast Rail Link (ECRL) cost was RM86 billion and claimed his government “reduced” it to RM75 billion. Construction alone accounts for RM50.27 billion, with an additional RM24.69 billion in interest and land acquisition costs. The project — a China-backed megaproject connecting the east and west coasts of Peninsular Malaysia — was renegotiated under Mahathir’s PH 1.0 government and continued under Muhyiddin and Ismail Sabri. Anwar’s government proceeded with construction, framing the RM11 billion “reduction” as a fiscal achievement.
